description:
About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role{{{{~}}}} 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Communications Intern who is best in class with a high IQ and EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team.

As a Marketing Growth Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Beyond executing campaigns, you'll be encouraged to help shape them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

What You'll Do{{{{~}}}}

Build and launch campaigns


Build marketing communications in our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages
Build and QA landing pages and campaign assets, making sure everything renders correctly before it reaches a single shopper
Own the day-to-day asset production flow{{{{~}}}} build, quality assurance, approvals, deployment, and communication with internal and external stakeholders
Manage the compliance and legal approval of assets.


Keep the operation running


Support day-to-day operations, keeping every marketing initiative up to date and on schedule
Maintain and organize campaign documentation — briefs, schedules, reports, and final assets
Identify potential risks early and come with a recommendation for how to mitigate them
Support the client and sales teams with in-app promotional setup and reporting


Measure and improve


Pull campaign performance data and report back on what actually happened
Recommend how to optimize the next campaign based on what the last one showed
Test copy, creative, and timing, and help work out which version earns its place
Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to speed up research, first drafts, and reporting


What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

Skills & Competencies


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Attention to detail is a must. There are plenty of moving parts within this role
Experience copywriting short and engaging messages
Comfortable with numbers — you can look at a table of campaign results and say something useful about it
Basic creative design skills and knowledge of Figma
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, copy, summaries — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field
Basic project management skills
Prior experience with Braze or another CRM/marketing automation platform is a plus
Experience building email templates or landing pages is a plus
Any experience with email, push notifications, in-app messaging, eCommerce, or digital marketing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You{{{{~}}}}


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome{{{{~}}}}

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation{{{{~}}}} The salary for the Marketing and Communications Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

description:
Associate (Intern) - General Merchandise 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. 
Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. 
Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. 
Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. 
Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. 
Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 


What will you be doing? 

This internship is designed for students to get hands-on, real-world experience working with a Client Development Team. The internship is for rising year 3 students, interested in pursuing a career in Insights, Analytics, CPG, Retail, Gen Merch or Market Research post-graduation.

Circana offers a full program to ensure ALL our associates gain:


Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve. 
Experience working on active projects that have actual impact on our business. 
Training on technical tools and behavioral skills that are critical to an employee’s success. 
Networking and mentor opportunities that can create personal connections. 


Job Responsibilities


Support a team responsible for helping a General Merchandise client (or multiple clients) understand their performance relative to the market and identify opportunities to grow their business and share of the market. 
Understand how to leverage Circana analytics to address clients’ business challenges and market opportunities. 
Translate data into actionable, analytic insights to drive Circana’s clients’ business performance. 
Shadow client meetings to present market research and insights. 
At Circana lateral, promotional, and cross-functional moves are encouraged and part of our culture. While your initial role will be in one of these groups, you’ll have the chance to grow your career both within your initial assignment and into other opportunities that meet your career goals. 


Requirements


Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree required in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field with a quantitative component, expecting to graduate between June 2027 and December 2027. 
Experience in or knowledge of the Retail or CPG industry preferred (e.g., School projects, case study, or relevant work experience). 
Academic knowledge/coursework in finance, economics, statistics, marketing or marketing analytics, data visualization, and/or logic is preferred. 
Strong intellectual curiosity and critical thinking ability, relentless attention to detail, strong written/verbal communication, ability to work collaboratively on a team, etc. 
Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus but not essential. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, etc.)
Technology aptitude and willingness to learn and work on new solutions and platforms. 
Creative problem-solving skills, ability to frame a business problem, design and execute an analysis plan, and understand and synthesize data findings into business insights and translate into creative data visualizations. 


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Description

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. As an Account Manager Intern you will join one of our business intelligence, retail, or seller services teams. The role provides an opportunity to understand Amazon business and processes, enhance analytical skills, and make significant business impact.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered and report on a set of business development targets
Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence
Use feedback to identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools

description:
Media Buyer & Ad Specialist (Meta Ads & GoHighLevel) | Remote – Mexico




Location: Mexico (100% Remote)

Job Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday – Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (EST/EDT)




About Social Refresh

Social Refresh is a US-based digital marketing and growth agency helping businesses scale through performance marketing, lead generation, sales systems, and customer acquisition strategies.




As we continue to grow, we're looking for a highly skilled, analytical, and results-driven Media Buyer & Ad Specialist to join our remote team in Mexico.




This is an opportunity for someone who understands the entire customer acquisition journey, from developing high-performing Meta Ads campaigns to building conversion-focused funnels and optimising the systems that turn leads into paying customers.




We're looking for someone who doesn't just manage advertising campaigns but takes genuine ownership of the results they produce.




About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Media Buyer & Ad Specialist who specialises in Meta Ads, funnel building, lead generation, and GoHighLevel.




This isn't a role where you'll simply launch ads, monitor dashboards, and report on performance.




We need someone who understands how paid advertising, landing pages, funnels, CRM systems, automation, and conversion optimisation work together to generate measurable business results.




You'll take ownership of Meta advertising campaigns, build and optimise conversion-focused funnels, manage CRM integrations, and continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.




Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel is essential. You'll be working extensively within the platform, building funnels, managing automations, and ensuring campaigns are connected to effective lead management systems.




Key Responsibilities




Meta Ads Management

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise Meta advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
Develop effective campaign strategies focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, and conversions.
Manage advertising budgets and continuously optimise campaign performance to maximise ROI.
Conduct audience research, targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing.
Monitor and analyse key performance metrics, including CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rates.
Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively implement improvements.
Collaborate on creative strategies, ad copy, and testing opportunities.
Take full ownership of campaign performance and the results delivered.




Funnel Building & Conversion Optimisation

Build, manage, and optimise high-converting landing pages and sales funnels.
Develop lead generation funnels designed to convert paid traffic into qualified leads.
Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates throughout the customer journey.
Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, funnel structures, and conversion elements.
Ensure advertising campaigns and funnels are strategically aligned to deliver measurable results.
Continuously improve funnel performance based on campaign data and conversion insights.




GoHighLevel & CRM Management

Build and manage funnels directly within GoHighLevel.
Set up and optimise forms, landing pages, pipelines, workflows, and automations.
Connect advertising campaigns with CRM systems to ensure accurate lead tracking and attribution.
Implement lead capture systems, automated follow-up sequences, and lead nurturing workflows.
Troubleshoot technical issues relating to funnels, integrations, automations, and lead tracking.
Ensure leads move effectively through the customer acquisition journey.




Performance Tracking & Reporting

Monitor campaign performance and provide clear, actionable insights.
Analyse lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and overall campaign effectiveness.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing performance and campaign profitability.
Maintain accurate campaign reporting and communicate results to internal stakeholders.
Proactively recommend and implement improvements based on performance data.
Take accountability for achieving agreed campaign performance targets.




Process Improvement & Collaboration

Collaborate with the Director of Marketing and internal team members to improve campaign strategies and execution.
Document successful campaign structures, funnel templates, testing frameworks, and reporting processes.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows through automation, technology, and AI.
Contribute to the development of scalable systems and processes as the business grows.
Participate in team meetings and maintain clear, proactive communication.




What We're Looking For




Essential Requirements

Proven hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns, preferably within a digital marketing agency.
Strong proficiency in Facebook Ads Manager and Meta Business Suite.
Demonstrated experience building, managing, and optimising lead generation funnels.
Practical, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel is required.
Ability to independently build funnels, configure workflows, manage pipelines, and troubleshoot integrations.
Strong understanding of Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, campaign attribution, and lead tracking.
Experience managing advertising budgets and optimising campaigns against performance targets.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimisation decisions.
Experience with A/B testing, audience targeting, retargeting, and conversion rate optimisation.
Ability to demonstrate measurable results from previous advertising campaigns.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a high level of accountability.




Highly Advantageous

Previous experience working with US-based clients or marketing agencies.
Experience managing multiple client advertising accounts simultaneously.
Experience with service-based businesses and lead generation campaigns.
Advanced knowledge of CRM integrations, automation tools, and lead nurturing strategies.
Experience with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, Grokbot, Higgsfield AI, and Wispr Flow.
Experience developing documented campaign processes, SOPs, and repeatable marketing systems.
Experience improving lead quality and conversion rates beyond the initial advertising campaign.




Who Will Thrive in This Role?

We're looking for someone who takes pride in delivering results, solving problems, and continuously improving their work.




You'll be a great fit if you're:

Results-driven: You care about generating qualified leads, improving conversions, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
Proactive: You identify problems, recommend solutions, and take initiative without waiting for instructions.
Analytical: You enjoy working with data and using performance insights to make better decisions.
Technically confident: You're comfortable building funnels, configuring integrations, and troubleshooting campaign issues independently.

Adaptable: You're comfortable working in a growing business where priorities can evolve quickly.
Tech-savvy: You're excited about leveraging technology, automation, and AI to work smarter.
Growth-minded: You're interested in building systems, improving processes, and developing into a more senior role over time.

100% remote opportunity based in Mexico.
Competitive USD-based compensation.
Full-time role working with a US-based marketing agency.
Opportunity to work with businesses across multiple industries.
Exposure to a variety of advertising campaigns, funnel strategies, and growth systems.

description:
Description

We're seeking a data-driven marketing professional to drive customer growth for Amazon Mexico's categories through lifecycle and outbound marketing, and to own the reporting that powers our Category Marketing team. This role combines deep analytical expertise with hands-on channel management to acquire, engage and retain customers across our business groups. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast-growing business.

The successful candidate will develop and execute lifecycle and outbound strategies (Push, Email, WhatsApp) that move customers through the funnel, from acquisition and first purchase to repeat purchase, Prime adoption and retention. They will act as the bridge between marketing channel owners and category teams, translating category needs into campaigns and programs and bringing company-wide priorities to category teams. They will also own the team's BI and reporting mechanisms, standardizing the metrics category teams use in their weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and SQL skills, a test-and-learn mindset, and the ability to simplify and scale through automation and AI. They communicate clearly across functions and levels, thrive with ambiguity and changing priorities, and enjoy a highly entrepreneurial environment. We are seeking someone with a proven track record in channel management, experimentation and project management.

Key job responsibilities

Lead category lifecycle strategy: analyze each category's customer funnel (active customers, new customer acquisition, repeat purchase, Prime adoption), present insights to category stakeholders, and plan and launch category-specific lifecycle initiatives.

Act as the point of contact for category-specific and company-wide lifecycle and Prime initiatives, coordinating execution with lifecycle and Prime teams.

Own category outbound marketing (Push, Email, WhatsApp): create campaigns for company priorities and major and seasonal events, ensure campaigns hit goals, and optimize performance across categories.

Drive experimentation across free outbound channels and WhatsApp, including customer acquisition and Prime tests. Document learnings and scale what works.

Own BI and reporting for the Category Marketing team: standardize weekly, monthly and quarterly metrics for category business reviews, with category-level drill-downs and visibility for all teams.

Deliver deep dives on campaign and funnel performance, with clear recommendations to category and marketing teams.

Increase category team adoption of lifecycle self-service tools, including engagement and gamification programs.

Lead efficiencies through AI and automation: semi-automated campaigns, automated reports and faster asset creation.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Lifecycle, Prime, Category Management, Vendor Management and BI teams.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience in a marketing role and proficient with analytic tools
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience in a marketing role
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Knowledge of analytic tools
 Experience using integrated campaigns to solve brand/business challenges

GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager
skills: Create, edit, and publish social media content (posts, graphics, product highlights, project features, educational content, and short-form videos for reels, TikToks, stories, and ads) across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Google Business Profile, and other platforms.
Manage social media accounts: post and schedule content, maintain the content calendar, and monitor comments, messages, and inquiries to direct prospects into the sales process.
Write captions, hooks, scripts, ad copy, email content, and landing-page copy in English and Spanish, and repurpose existing project photos, product information, and approved manufacturer content.

Develop and run paid and organic campaigns that generate customer inquiries and qualified leads, defining target audiences, ad copy, creative, and geographic focus (for example, contractors and builders in one region versus window dealers in another).

Tailor strategies to the construction industry, including the buying cycles, decision-makers, and project timelines of homeowners, contractors, builders, remodelers, developers, and property managers.
Monitor performance (cost per lead, engagement, click-through rate, conversions), run A/B tests, and prepare periodic reports with recommended improvements.
Research competitors, industry trends, and new lead-generation channels, and test new strategies for residential and commercial opportunities.

Coordinate with designers, clients, and sales, estimating, administrative, and management teams to deliver content on time and route qualified leads correctly, and help track leads through the sales funnel.
Support other related marketing, advertising, research, and sales-support activities when needed.
3-5 years of experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, advertising, and/or lead generation.
Strong experience creating social media content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook, with solid short-form video editing skills (reels, TikToks, stories, ads).
Fluency in English and Spanish, with strong writing, copywriting, and communication skills in both languages.
Experience creating and managing paid campaigns with Meta Business Suite, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, and Google Ads, plus familiarity with Google Business Profile.
Ability to interpret marketing analytics and adjust campaigns accordingly, and experience with CRM platforms and lead-management processes.
Experience managing content calendars and keeping a consistent posting rhythm, with a strong eye for design, trends, and storytelling.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, stay organized, and manage multiple campaigns and content pieces at the same time.

Strongly preferred: marketing experience in construction, home improvement, building materials, windows and doors, remodeling, or related industries, including an understanding of project-based purchasing, multiple decision-makers, contractor relationships, and bid and estimate processes.
Strongly preferred: experience marketing to both B2C and B2B audiences (homeowners, contractors, builders, remodelers, developers, or property managers).
Nice to have: experience with tools like Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, or similar platforms.
description:
Content Creator & Social Media Manager

About us

Job Title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $1400-$1600 USD




Important: Only CVs submitted in English will be considered.

Higher Options is looking for a Digital Marketing, Lead Generation & Content Specialist who is highly focused on content creation, social media management, video editing, and lead generation for a U.S.-based client in the construction and building-materials industry.

This role is ideal for someone creative, organized, commercially minded, and hands-on, who can create engaging content, manage paid and organic channels, and turn online engagement into qualified sales leads. Experience marketing in construction, home improvement, building materials, windows and doors, or remodeling is strongly preferred.

Requirements

Job Terms:

Full-Time Position: 40 hours/week

Potential Benefits: Paid vacation and national holidays, depending on the client.

Opportunities for Advancement: Grow with these companies and advance in your career.

Contract Type: CONTRATO DE PRESTACIÓN DE SERVICIOS. The employee is responsible for their own social security, pension payments, and benefits.

title: UX Writer + Conversacional
description:
¡Multiplica te estás buscando! Somos una consultora especializada en ofrecer las mejores oportunidades laborales al

mejor talento digital del mercado. Tenemos más de 25 años de experiencia reclutando a personas capacitadas, innovadoras y con ganas de crecer para nuestros clientes.

Actualmente colaboramos con empresas en LATAM, USA, Europa y África y contamos con talentos que trabajan presencialmente y/o remoto en diferentes partes del mundo. Nuestros talentos son los agentes de cambio que están creando las organizaciones del futuro. ¡Sé parte de este cambio!

MISIÓN/OBJETIVOS DEL PUESTO:

Diseñar experiencias conversacionales claras, precisas y humanas, y crear contenido de calidad para productos digitales. description:
About McKinney-Vento.org




McKinney-Vento.org (MV Learning, LLC) provides training and software to the people in US school districts responsible for supporting students experiencing homelessness. Under the federal McKinney-Vento Act, every district has a designated liaison for these students, and our platform gives those liaisons the training, tools, and workflows they need to identify students, meet compliance requirements, and get kids the support they are entitled to.




We work with school districts across the country, through direct district partnerships and through state and regional agreements that open our training to every district in the area. We are a small, close-knit team, and the work matters: the faster a district is up and running, the sooner its students get help.




The role




We are hiring a Training Customer Support Specialist to make sure the districts we already work with actually get value from what they have.




Here is the problem you will own. A district signs on, or gains access through a state or regional partnership, and then nothing happens. The liaison is busy, may not realize what they have access to, and often does not respond to email. In our experience, once we reach them by phone, they are glad we called and happy to get started. Your job is to be that call.




You will work from our “at risk” lists: districts that have not yet onboarded, and districts that have onboarded but whose staff are not completing training at the level we would like. You will reach out to them one by one, mostly by phone and also by email and Zoom, walk them step by step through onboarding, answer questions about our products, and help them get their liaisons trained. When something needs fixing or a question is beyond your scope, you coordinate with our Launch team and Account Manager to get it resolved.




This is not a sales role. Every conversation you have is with an existing client. It is about retention, adoption, and making sure the people we serve get what they are already entitled to.




The rhythm of the role follows the school year. Renewals and fiscal-year openings (around July 1) and the start of the school year are busy; other stretches are quieter, and we expect you to use that time with autonomy, improving materials, cleaning up data, and getting ahead on outreach.




What you will do




Outbound outreach to at-risk districts. Work daily through our lists of districts that have not onboarded or are under-using their training, primarily by phone, supported by email and Zoom.
Run onboarding. Schedule and lead onboarding meetings over Zoom, and guide liaisons step by step through registration, account setup, and getting their staff into the training.
Provide training and product support. Answer questions about our products and services, demonstrate features, and help clients get unstuck.
Monitor training success. Pull and send monthly training success reports to the districts we work with, spot districts that are falling behind, and act on red flags early.
Follow up on self-registration. Send reminders and check in with districts that chose to self-register but have not completed the process.
Coordinate internally. Work closely with the Launch team and Account Manager to resolve issues, escalate questions, and keep client records and notes current in our systems.
Improve the process. Keep outreach scripts, email templates, and onboarding guides current, and tell us what is and is not working.
Flex with the seasons. Help where the team needs it most during quieter periods, which may include light outreach support for the account management team.




What we are looking for




Excellent spoken and written English. You will spend most of your day on the phone and in email with US school district staff, and you need to be clear, warm, and professional in both.
Comfortable on the phone. You are happy to pick up the phone and call someone who has not replied to three emails, and you can turn a cold reception into a productive conversation.
Patient, friendly, and persistent. Our clients are busy educators. You can explain the same thing many times without losing your enthusiasm, and you do not give up after one unanswered call.
Organized and self-directed. You can manage a long list of districts, keep accurate notes, follow up on time, and stay productive without someone looking over your shoulder.
Comfortable with software. You can learn a web platform well enough to teach it, and you are at ease with Zoom, email and Google docs.
A problem-solver. When a client hits a wall, you figure out whether you can solve it, and if not, who can, and you follow it through to resolution.
Reliable availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern.
2+ years of experience in customer success, client onboarding, training, support, or a similar client-facing role.




Bonus points




Experience working with US K-12 schools, school districts, or education-sector clients
Experience onboarding or training customers on a SaaS or LMS product
Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM
Familiarity with the McKinney-Vento Act or student homelessness programs




Why McKinney-Vento.org




Work that matters. Every district you get onboarded means students experiencing homelessness get identified and supported sooner.

description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Customer Engineering Team

Mixpanel's Customer Engineering teams are analytics consultants who embed themselves within our enterprise customer teams to drive business outcomes. We work with prospects and customers throughout the customer journey to understand what drives value, and serve as the technical counterpart to our Sales organisation to deliver on that value.

You will partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Value Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support to successfully roll out self-serve analytics within our customers' organisations, help manage change, execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers, and ultimately drive ROI on the customer's Mixpanel investment.

About The Role

Our Customer Engineers are inquisitive, nimble, and able to clearly articulate the technical benefits and requirements of Mixpanel to developers and product managers, while also communicating the business value of our product to senior executives.

In your first month, you'll become a Mixpanel expert—both in features and functionality as well as implementation. You'll shadow customer calls and demos with current Customer Engineers and Account Executives while learning to articulate our value proposition, and be trained on Mixpanel's internal systems and tools.

Within your first three months, you'll be directly involved in deal cycles with Account Executives. You'll lead the technical qualification for customer use cases and deliver customised demos for prospects and existing customers, working directly with leadership at the prospect's organisation to understand business challenges that can be solved through an analytics platform.

You'll also work with the prospect's business and technical teams to scope and execute proof-of-concept projects to establish Mixpanel's value—including consulting on data ingestion methods, overall architecture, success criteria, and rollout strategies for analytics tools across an organisation.

Responsibilities


Serve as a trusted technical advisor for prospects, providing strategic consultation on data architecture, governance, instrumentation, and business outcomes
Communicate and consult effectively at all levels of the customer's organisation to earn trust and influence buying decisions
Bridge the technical-business gap—working with senior stakeholders to define success for proofs-of-concept and ensuring successful execution and outcomes
Leverage your Mixpanel expertise and technical/consultative skills to impart best practices throughout proof-of-concept projects
Partner with Account Executives to drive revenue growth, serving as the key technical contact for customers
Partner with post-sales teams to ensure that pre-sales value propositions translate into tangible post-sales results
Develop relationships and uncover the needs of key technical stakeholders within your assigned book of business
Be the "Voice of the Prospect" by collecting feedback from potential Mixpanel customers and sharing it with the Product team


We're Looking For Someone Who Has


Fluency in business and conversational Spanish and English.
The ability to communicate with stakeholders at all levels—from discussing APIs with developers to organisational efficiency with CIOs.
A demonstrated track record of qualifying and selling technical solutions to executive stakeholders
6+ years of experience in a Software-as-a-Service Sales Engineering or related role
Experience in data querying, modelling, and transformation using tools such as SQL, dbt, Python, Business Intelligence platforms, or Product Analytics tools
Familiarity with databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks)
A successful record of experience in sales engineering, consulting, or technical project management
Excellent written, analytical, communication, and presentation skills
Strong process and project delivery discipline
Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini
The ability to travel as needed


Bonus Points For


Experience with value engineering frameworks: translating customer pain into quantified business outcomes, building ROI calculators, and leading executive-level value conversations tied to measurable KPIs
Exposure to product-led growth (PLG) environments and sales-assisted conversion motions
Background in high-growth SaaS environments (Series B–E or beyond)


Benefits And Perks

Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

In this role, you’d be joining the Professional Services team. Our team’s mission is to empower every Stripe user to achieve maximum value from their investment quickly and confidently. Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by supporting the success of our large, intricate Stripe implementations. This involves guiding users through their integration process, project planning, coordinating with stakeholders, handling deliverables, meeting key timelines, and educating our users about the maximum potential they can achieve with Stripe.

As an Implementation Consultant at Stripe, you are the driving force behind these strategic implementations. Your role is key in leading them through the integration process, turning them into long-term transacting Stripe users. Our team’s core objective is to provide an efficient, seamless transition for our clients, assuring top-notch user satisfaction and relationship management.

What you’ll do

As an Implementation Consultant, you will be managing the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch. You will proactively develop and manage integration architecture, change management strategy, and timelines. You will be expected to collaborate across departments, including Sales, Technical Services, Product, and Engineering, to ensure a successful transition for our clients.

Responsibilities


Own the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch.
Develop, manage, and implement a customer’s integration architecture, change management strategy, and timeline.
Partner with other Sales and Technical Services teams to improve the overall Stripe user journey.
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy for large users.
Collaborate with teammates on strategic projects that improve and scale our implementation process and team operations.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


4+ years of experience working with strategic customers on technology solutions, with a track record of top performance
Ability to understand complex business requirements and craft tailored solutions
Quick learner with the ability to explain technical concepts to Stripe’s largest customers
Proven project management skills and strong critical thinking abilities
Experience identifying and solving internal process inefficiencies
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate independently in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
Experience in the payments industry
Knowledge of APIs
Knowledge of SQL



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
QUIÉNES SOMOS

Haute Custom Beauty es una marca internacional de skincare con laboratorio propio en Barcelona y spas en Barcelona, Austin y Ciudad de México. Formulamos nuestros productos y los usamos en cabina. Combinamos tres generaciones de experiencia en spa con investigación y biotecnología. Nuestro sistema DermaProfiles™ distingue más de 800 perfiles de piel y nos permite formular sueros a la medida.




Nuestro tratamiento insignia ha sido reconocido como Mejor Facial de España y nuestro concepto de spa fue premiado por Salón Look de IFEMA en la categoría de estética. Vogue México nos colocó en el primer lugar de su selección editorial de faciales en CDMX. Nuestro facial insignia se ofrece en Waldorf Astoria Riviera Maya y en Kilolani Spa de Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort, en Maui, Hawái. Hemos llevado nuestras experiencias a Harrods, Galeries Lafayette y Saks Fifth Avenue. Nuestra trayectoria incluye el sello español de Pyme Innovadora.




TU MISIÓN

Acompañar a nuestras clientas después de comprar productos dermatológicos, recibir un tratamiento en el spa o acudir a un servicio de medicina estética. Queremos que cada persona sepa cómo continuar su cuidado y tenga claro el siguiente paso.




QUÉ HARÁS

• Dar seguimiento por WhatsApp y teléfono, reforzar las indicaciones autorizadas y canalizar las dudas clínicas al especialista correspondiente.

• Agendar, confirmar y reprogramar citas. Orientar sobre reposición de productos cuando corresponda.

• Mantener actualizado el CRM con las conversaciones, acuerdos y próximos pasos de cada clienta.

• Revisar las notas de las skin coaches y esteticistas, pedir que completen la información faltante y dar seguimiento hasta que quede registrada.




QUÉ BUSCAMOS

• Experiencia en coordinación de pacientes, atención en clínicas o spas, asesoría dermocosmética, cosmetología o seguimiento posventa.

• Excelente redacción, trato cálido y capacidad para organizar conversaciones, citas y pendientes.

• Manejo de WhatsApp, agenda digital y CRM. Se valora el conocimiento de skincare.




QUÉ OFRECEMOS

• $18,000 MXN brutos mensuales de sueldo base.

• Bono operativo mensual de $4,000 MXN al alcanzar al menos 80% de ocupación del spa y cumplir los criterios de seguimiento, registros completos en el CRM y entrega de reportes.

• Bono comercial mensual de $2,000, $3,000 o $5,000 MXN, según el ticket promedio.

• 3% de comisión sobre tus ventas de producto.

• Ingresos totales potenciales de $30,000 a $40,000 MXN brutos al mes, incluyendo bonos y comisiones, según tus resultados.

• Contratación por nómina, bajo el régimen de sueldos y salarios, con prestaciones de ley.

• Capacitación en skincare y participación en Camino de las Estrellas, con evaluaciones periódicas para avanzar de nivel.




LUGAR Y HORARIO

Presencial en Monte Líbano 215, Lomas de Chapultepec, Ciudad de México. Horario previsto de martes a sábado, de 11:00 a 20:30, con una hora para comer. Descanso domingo y lunes.




POSTULACIÓN

Postúlate por LinkedIn con tu CV. El proceso incluye preguntas filtro y una entrevista con IA en español para perfiles que avancen, con casos simulados de seguimiento por WhatsApp, manejo del CRM y agenda de citas. El equipo de selección revisará tus respuestas.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused and detail-oriented individual to be a founding Service Delivery Manager on our Customer Data Services team. You’ll own the delivery of our Data Ingestion service packages end‑to‑end—from scoping the customer’s data landscape to aligning timelines and managing service hours—ensuring a predictable, on‑time, on‑budget experience that accelerates customer time-to-value. You’ll work closely with our customers, external partners, and with internal stakeholders such as Data Specialists, Customer Success Managers, and Sustainability Data Advisors to ensure the successful delivery of our services.

You will:


Own end‑to‑end delivery of Data Ingestion service packages: Run kickoff, define scope and success criteria, build project plans, manage execution through completion, and hand off cleanly to post-go live teams
Scope packages and solutions: Lead discovery to understand the customer’s data sources, formats, owners, and quality constraints, and coordinate with partners on potential solutions. 
Align on timelines and hold accountability: Set clear, reasonable timelines with customers and in collaboration with partners; sequence dependencies across internal and customer teams. Hold internal collaborators and customers accountable to milestones; renegotiate timelines transparently when inputs change. 
Control service hours and budget: Track work against quoted hours; forecast burn and course‑correct early to stay within budget. Identify out‑of‑scope requests; manage change to protect margin and customer trust. 
Identify risks and escalations: Proactively surface risks (e.g., missing data owners, low data quality, timeline slippage); drive mitigation plans and timely escalations. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 3-6 years of experience delivering client services in B2B software or consulting
Have directly owned client relationships and are energized by solving client problems
Are customer obsessed and operate with high ownership; you anticipate needs and remove blockers without being asked. 
Are detail-oriented with strong organization skills; you keep scope, timelines, and artifacts tight and current. 
Identify risks proactively and solve problems in a structured manner; you raise issues early with options and tradeoffs. 
Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are motivated, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
