About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design{{{{~}}}} every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $3,000 - $3,750 per month (Gross in USD)

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight

Strategy & Execution

Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift

GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

ABM Manager at BairesDev

This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. - Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

skills: Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The opportunity


Build and scale a KOL/creator network in Spain, Iberia and other countries for Kraken Pro from the ground up
Drive new trading user acquisition through influencer and creator partnerships across the region
Own end-to-end relationship management with local KOLs, from sourcing to activation
Represent Kraken Pro's derivatives suite — perpetual futures, prop trading, margin — to top regional creators
Fix on-the-ground execution issues that block program performance and iterate fast
Set and own regional KOL acquisition targets and CAC efficiency
Partner cross-functionally with growth, marketing, and compliance teams
Benchmark and adapt a proven KOL playbook


What You Bring


Proven track record building an influencer/KOL/creator network from scratch in Spain and/or the Iberia region
Fluent Spanish (Portuguese a plus), deep fluency in the local crypto/trading creator ecosystem
Experience acquiring trading users at scale with a clear eye on CAC
Hands-on, get-it-done approach — solves problems on the ground rather than escalating
High agency — owns regional strategy without waiting for global direction
Understanding of perpetual futures, margin, and prop trading products
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous, 24/7 crypto environment
Strong relationship-management and negotiation skills with creators/KOLs


Nice to haves


Existing personal network of crypto KOLs/creators in Spain/Iberia and other countries
Prior KOL, growth, or influencer marketing role at a crypto exchange


Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

🚀 Junior Affiliate Manager | Influencer Relations Specialist




¿Eres de las personas que siempre están descubriendo nuevos creadores de contenido, siguiendo tendencias en redes sociales y conectando fácilmente con otras personas?

Si además te interesa desarrollar una carrera en Affiliate Marketing, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Somos un holding internacional de tecnología con más de 8 años desarrollando y promoviendo nuestros propios productos de entretenimiento digital. Actualmente buscamos un Junior Affiliate Manager para integrarse a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a seguir expandiendo nuestra red global de afiliados.

En este rol trabajarás con influencers, streamers, YouTubers, administradores de canales de Telegram, propietarios de sitios web, blogueros y otros creadores de contenido, construyendo alianzas que generen valor para ambas partes.

Lo mejor: no buscamos años y años de experiencia, buscamos personas con iniciativa, curiosidad y muchas ganas de aprender.







¿Cómo será tu día a día?




Serás quien identifique nuevas oportunidades de colaboración en plataformas digitales, contacte potenciales socios y construya relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:

Buscar e identificar creadores de contenido y afiliados con potencial para colaborar con la empresa.
Prospectar y generar conversaciones a través de plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, X y Twitch.
Presentar nuestros productos y negociar nuevas colaboraciones.
Dar seguimiento a cada oportunidad hasta convertirla en una alianza comercial.
Gestionar la relación con los afiliados activos y detectar nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.
Participar en campañas, proyectos especiales y eventos internacionales del sector.

¿Qué buscamos?




Queremos conocer personas con un perfil comercial, gusto por las redes sociales y facilidad para construir relaciones.

Idealmente cuentas con:

✔ Entre 1 y 2 años de experiencia en ventas, atención al cliente, prospección digital, influencer marketing, account management o desarrollo de negocios.

✔ Experiencia o interés en contactar clientes, afiliados o creadores de contenido mediante redes sociales y plataformas digitales.

✔ Excelente comunicación escrita y habilidad para negociar de manera natural.

✔ Capacidad para organizar varias conversaciones y oportunidades al mismo tiempo.

✔ Curiosidad por investigar perfiles, detectar tendencias y encontrar nuevas oportunidades de colaboración.

✔ Actitud proactiva, orientación a resultados y muchas ganas de seguir aprendiendo.







Sumarás puntos si tienes experiencia en:

Affiliate Marketing.
Influencer Marketing.
Social Selling.
Business Development.
Account Management.
Publicidad Digital o Marketing de Performance.
Idiomas adicionales.







¿Qué ofrecemos?

✨ Salario competitivo con revisiones salariales y bonos por desempeño.

📄 Contrato por prestación de servicios, acompañado de beneficios competitivos.

🏖️ 28 días de vacaciones pagadas al año, aguinaldo, prima vacacional e incapacidades totalmente pagadas.

📚 Capacitación especializada y plan de crecimiento dentro de una empresa internacional.

⏰ Jornada de 7 horas diarias + 1 hora de comida, con horario flexible de entrada entre las 10:00 y las 14:00 horas.

🏢 Posición 100% presencial, ubicada sobre Insurgentes Sur, Ciudad de México.

🌎 Un ambiente internacional, dinámico y colaborativo, donde tendrás contacto con creadores de contenido de diferentes países y podrás desarrollar una carrera dentro del ecosistema de Affiliate Marketing.

Si te entusiasma la idea de combinar redes sociales, prospección digital, negociación y desarrollo de alianzas, nos encantará conocerte.

Postúlate y forma parte de un equipo que sigue creciendo a nivel global.

title: Senior Specialist, Creative Strategy & Performance (Paid Marketing)
skills: Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements
Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework
Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs
Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines
Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously
Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models
Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.
description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.
Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.

title: Cofundador
description:
Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico — Leviathan Network




Descripción de la empresa




Leviathan Network es una plataforma tecnológica diseñada para que los fundadores puedan presentar, desarrollar y hacer crecer sus startups y productos, documentando públicamente su evolución y conectándose con las personas, organizaciones e instituciones que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Leviathan abarca el ciclo completo de las startups, desde el desarrollo de una idea hasta su crecimiento y consolidación, integrando talento, colaboradores, clientes, usuarios, capital, conocimiento, oportunidades e instituciones.




La plataforma permite desarrollar proyectos, documentar públicamente su evolución y encontrar conexiones y oportunidades para crecer.




Descripción del puesto




Como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico de Leviathan Network, la persona seleccionada será responsable de liderar y ejecutar la estrategia de marketing, comunicación, creación de contenido, posicionamiento, adquisición y crecimiento de la plataforma.




El objetivo será posicionar y hacer crecer Leviathan, construir una comunidad activa e incorporar fundadores, startups, productos, profesionales, organizaciones e instituciones.




La posición requiere tanto capacidad estratégica como de ejecución. No se busca únicamente a alguien que diseñe estrategias, administre campañas o supervise a terceros, sino a una persona capaz de involucrarse directamente en la creación de los materiales de marketing que necesita Leviathan.




Esto incluye diseñar piezas gráficas, crear contenido visual y audiovisual, desarrollar publicaciones, producir materiales de comunicación, administrar redes sociales, redactar textos, editar contenido y gestionar su publicación y distribución en distintos canales digitales.




Deberá transformar las funcionalidades, propuestas de valor y avances de Leviathan en contenido atractivo y comprensible que genere interés y nuevos usuarios.




También deberá desarrollar y gestionar la presencia digital de Leviathan, identificar oportunidades de crecimiento orgánico y pagado, implementar estrategias de adquisición, trabajar en SEO, gestionar campañas publicitarias, analizar resultados y optimizar las acciones implementadas.




El puesto integra diseño, creatividad, producción de contenido, comunicación, marketing y adquisición de usuarios en una misma estrategia de crecimiento.




Participará en la definición de la identidad comunicacional y la marca, así como en la manera de presentar Leviathan ante sus diferentes públicos.




Tipo de puesto: Cofundador / Socio Estratégico

Dedicación: Jornada completa (Full-time)

Modalidad de compensación: 5% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network).




Requisitos




- Experiencia sólida en marketing digital y crecimiento.

- Experiencia en diseño gráfico y creación de materiales visuales para medios digitales.

- Capacidad para desarrollar piezas gráficas, creatividades publicitarias, publicaciones y materiales de comunicación.

- Experiencia en creación, producción y edición de contenido para redes sociales.

- Conocimiento de formatos y estrategias de contenido para Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube y otras redes relevantes.

- Capacidad para desarrollar calendarios editoriales y planificar publicaciones.

- Experiencia administrando redes sociales y gestionando comunidades digitales.

- Capacidad para redactar textos publicitarios, publicaciones, mensajes comerciales y contenido informativo.

- Conocimiento de edición de video y producción audiovisual.

- Experiencia desarrollando estrategias de adquisición y posicionamiento para productos tecnológicos.

- Experiencia en construcción y posicionamiento de marcas.

- Conocimiento de estrategias de crecimiento orgánico y pagado.

- Experiencia con SEO, marketing de contenidos y marketing de performance.

- Capacidad para desarrollar estrategias de adquisición y conversión.

- Conocimiento de analítica y medición de resultados.

- Capacidad para identificar canales de crecimiento.

- Experiencia trabajando con startups, plataformas digitales, SaaS, marketplaces o productos tecnológicos.

- Capacidad para desarrollar estrategias de construcción de comunidad.

- Capacidad para adaptar la comunicación a diferentes perfiles de usuarios y participantes.

- Pensamiento orientado a resultados y crecimiento.

- Autonomía para definir estrategias, crear materiales, ejecutar acciones y medir resultados.

- Capacidad para participar directamente en la definición y evolución de la estrategia de Leviathan.




Se valorará que pueda desarrollar por sí misma el proceso completo de creación de contenido, desde la conceptualización hasta la publicación y análisis.




Perfil que requiere Leviathan




Se busca una persona que combine conocimientos de marketing con capacidades creativas, de diseño, producción de contenido y gestión de redes sociales.




Debe construir la presencia digital de Leviathan: identificar qué comunicar, desarrollar ideas, diseñar piezas, producir contenidos, redactar, editar y gestionar publicaciones.




Deberá convertir las funcionalidades de la plataforma en contenido atractivo y comprensible.




Esto implica saber comunicar el valor de Leviathan mediante distintos formatos, como:




- Diseños gráficos y publicaciones visuales.

- Carruseles informativos.

- Videos cortos y contenido audiovisual.

- Reels y TikToks.

- Videos explicativos y demostraciones de funcionalidades.

- Infografías y materiales promocionales.

- Publicaciones editoriales.

- Campañas publicitarias.

- Contenido educativo e informativo.




El contenido debe responder a objetivos de posicionamiento, reconocimiento de marca, interacción, adquisición y crecimiento de la comunidad, no solo mantener activas las redes.




Deberá lograr que Leviathan sea conocido, entendido, utilizado y recomendado, comprendiendo el recorrido del usuario desde el descubrimiento y registro hasta su participación y permanencia en el ecosistema.




Se valorará combinar diseño, creatividad, comunicación, marketing y análisis, sin depender exclusivamente de terceros para producir contenido.




Se requiere criterio estratégico, creatividad, capacidad técnica, autonomía y orientación a resultados.




Responsabilidades principales




- Diseñar y desarrollar la estrategia de marketing y crecimiento de Leviathan Network.

- Desarrollar el posicionamiento de Leviathan frente a sus diferentes públicos y fortalecer su identidad comunicacional.

- Construir y fortalecer la presencia digital y el reconocimiento de marca.

- Diseñar y producir materiales gráficos para las diferentes plataformas y canales de comunicación.

- Crear contenido visual y audiovisual para redes sociales.

- Desarrollar conceptos creativos para publicaciones, campañas y materiales promocionales.

- Redactar textos, mensajes, publicaciones y contenidos relacionados con la comunicación de Leviathan.

- Editar y producir videos cortos, videos explicativos y otros formatos audiovisuales.

- Diseñar carruseles, infografías, publicaciones y recursos visuales informativos.

- Planificar y gestionar calendarios de contenido.

- Administrar las redes sociales de Leviathan y gestionar su publicación y actividad.

- Desarrollar estrategias de contenido específicas para cada plataforma social.

- Gestionar la distribución del contenido y optimizar su alcance orgánico.

- Incrementar la comunidad y atraer seguidores relevantes.

- Desarrollar estrategias para atraer fundadores y startups.

- Atraer profesionales, talento, organizaciones e instituciones al ecosistema.

- Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de contenido orientadas a la captación y conversión de usuarios.

- Desarrollar y optimizar estrategias de SEO.

- Diseñar y gestionar campañas de publicidad digital.

- Identificar nuevos canales de adquisición y crecimiento.

- Desarrollar estrategias de conversión y retención.

- Medir el rendimiento del contenido, las redes sociales y las campañas.

- Analizar métricas de alcance, interacción, tráfico, registros, adquisición y conversión.

- Identificar oportunidades de mejora en el recorrido de adquisición y conversión.

- Experimentar, medir y optimizar continuamente las estrategias implementadas.

- Desarrollar materiales y mensajes que expliquen claramente el valor de Leviathan.

- Adaptar las acciones de marketing conforme evolucione la plataforma y aumente el número de fundadores, startups y participantes.




Lo que ofrece Leviathan




- 5% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network) a cambio de asumir la responsabilidad estratégica y operativa del marketing, diseño, creación y distribución de contenido, gestión de redes sociales y adquisición de usuarios.

- Participación como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico.

- Participación directa en las decisiones relacionadas con el posicionamiento, crecimiento, comunicación y estrategia de marketing.

- Un papel estratégico y operativo en la construcción de la marca y expansión de la plataforma.

- La oportunidad de participar en el desarrollo de una plataforma tecnológica enfocada en abarcar el ciclo completo de las startups.




Lo que representa el puesto




Este no es un puesto convencional de marketing, administración de redes sociales ni una contratación tradicional de servicios. Como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico, la persona tendrá una participación directa en el crecimiento de Leviathan y una responsabilidad fundamental sobre su posicionamiento, comunicación, creación de contenido, presencia digital, adquisición y expansión.




El reto consiste en convertir el valor de Leviathan en una propuesta que pueda ser entendida, adoptada y difundida por sus diferentes públicos, desarrollando tanto la estrategia como los materiales creativos y los canales necesarios para impulsar la plataforma.




La posición requiere visión estratégica, creatividad, diseño, producción de contenido, gestión de redes sociales, ejecución de marketing, análisis y orientación a resultados, con una participación directamente vinculada al crecimiento de Leviathan Network.

Desired: Experience working directly with hobby retailers or small businesses.

Susurros del Corazón, Auberge Collection, is a vibrant oceanfront enclave set between jungled cliffs and a pristine stretch of shoreline overlooking Bahía de Banderas in Punta de Mita on Mexico’s Pacific Coast. The resort offers 82 ocean-view studios, casitas, and suites, along with 30 two- to five-bedroom casas and oceanfront residences, highlighted by a seven-bedroom signature villa. The resort is home to several dining venues, including Casamilpa, a signature restaurant featuring Mediterranean cuisine with Mexican influences, La Boquita, an open-air taqueria, as well as a pool bar, private cabanas, and captivating epicurean experiences exploring global flavors. Three infinity-edge pools cascading down to the beach and Morritos Kids Club create a haven for relaxation and family memories. description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.

About The Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.

Requirements

The Role

As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.

You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.

This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.

What You'll Own


Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R
Reporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on
Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must


Problems to Solve

Metrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.

Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.

Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.

A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard
Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull
You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered
The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work


Who You Are

AI-Native: You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand.

Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique.

Sets the Bar: As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards.

Team Player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together.

Business Focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive.

Bias for Action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go.

This Role Is NOT


A ticket queue. You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it
A dashboard-admin seat. Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers
A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage
A role that waits for perfectly clean data. If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse


Tools of the Trade

SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting.

Benefits


Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually
AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify
Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours
Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged


VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.

Requirements

The Role

As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.

You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.

This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.

What You'll Own


Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R
Reporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on
Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must


Problems to Solve

Metrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.

Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.

Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.

A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard
Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull
You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered
The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work


Who You Are

AI-Native: You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand.

Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique.

Sets the Bar: As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards.

Team Player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together.

Business Focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive.

Bias for Action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go.

This Role Is NOT


A ticket queue. You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it
A dashboard-admin seat. Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers
A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage
A role that waits for perfectly clean data. If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse


Tools of the Trade

SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting.

Benefits


Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually
AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify
Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours
Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged

ACERCA DE CHILDREN INTERNATIONAL




Children International agencia Jalisco es una asociación afiliada de Children International, una organización global sin fines de lucro con oficinas centrales en Kansas City, Estados Unidos.

Children International (CI) implementa programas de desarrollo de la niñez y juventud en todo el mundo, con el objetivo de romper el ciclo de la pobreza generacional. Con un enfoque personalizado y de largo plazo, acompañamos a niñas, niños y jóvenes en 10 países durante las dos primeras décadas de sus vidas. Al brindarles acceso a educación, atención médica y referentes positivos, junto con habilidades para la vida y competencias laborales, les ayudamos a convertirse en adultos empoderados, con empleos sostenibles y capaces de mejorar sus vidas, las de sus familias y sus comunidades. Nuestro compromiso es permanente, porque sabemos que los casi 220,000 niños, niñas y jóvenes a quienes apoyamos merecen una verdadera oportunidad.




OPORTUNIDAD LABORAL 




El/la Líder de alianzas de salud y educación (Líder de Capacidad 5) supervisa las iniciativas de la agencia que fortalecen las relaciones y los entornos de apoyo para niños, niñas, adolescentes y jóvenes. El puesto coordina el trabajo con personas cuidadoras, escuelas, servicios de salud, instituciones comunitarias y socios para traducir la estrategia en acciones sostenibles y de calidad.

description:
Earthjustice is the United States' leading environmental law organization. We wield the power of law and the strength of partnership to protect people’s health, preserve magnificent places and wildlife, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. We are here because the Earth needs a good lawyer.

Earthjustice's International Program works across borders to protect the global environment. Drawing on deep experience in human rights law, environmental law, and energy law and policy, we work with partners around the world using strategic legal advocacy to reduce dependence on dirty fossil fuels, accelerate deployment of clean energy, protect biodiversity, and defend human rights.

Earthjustice’s International Program seeks a Mexico-based Communications Strategist to strengthen the impact of our work with partner organizations in Latin America. The International Program works in partnership with public interest legal organizations in Mexico and elsewhere in Latin America to establish, strengthen, and enforce national and international legal protections for the environment and communities.

The Communications Strategist will develop and advise on communications strategies for legal and advocacy efforts to protect the human right to a healthy environment and promote a just energy transition. The work will focus on Mexico, and additional work related to Argentina, Colombia, and Chile and other regional priorities as needed.

The goal of this work is to help partner organizations raise the profile of public interest legal work, reach priority audiences, and increase the impact of cases and campaigns. In this role, the Communications Strategist will work with Earthjustice staff and partner organizations to translate complex legal, scientific, and technical issues into clear, compelling, and accurate public communications. The Strategist will help identify media opportunities, develop strategic messaging, strengthen partner communications, and support public narratives that advance environmental protection, clean air, a just energy transition, and the human right to a healthy environment.

The Communications Strategist will work as part of a team based in Mexico City and will collaborate closely with Earthjustice International Program staff at all stages of the work.

The successful candidate will be engaged as an employee of an Employer of Record (EOR) rather than employed by Earthjustice directly.

Earthjustice es la principal organización de derecho ambiental sin ánimo de lucro de interés público especializada en derecho ambiental en Estados Unidos. Dominio profesional oral y escrito del español y del inglés.

Buen criterio en contextos de incidencia políticamente sensibles o de alto impacto, incluida la capacidad de coordinar las comunicaciones prestando especial atención a las perspectivas de las comunidades afectadas.
Capacidad para establecer prioridades, gestionar múltiples plazos y responder con rapidez a nuevas oportunidades y acontecimientos.


Rango Salarial:

El rango salarial para este puesto es de MXN MXN 878,000 – 960,000 (approximately USD 45,500 – 56,000).

La compensación final será acorde con la experiencia y las cualificaciones de la persona seleccionada.

MODALIDAD DE CONTRATACIÓN: La persona seleccionada será contratada como empleada por medio de un Employer of Record (EOR), y no directamente por Earthjustice. Las prestaciones serán proporcionadas por el EOR y podrán diferir de las que se ofrecen a los empleados de Earthjustice.

Para Postularse

Las personas interesadas deberán enviar los siguientes documentos a través de Jobvite. Se dará prioridad a las solicitudes enviadas a más tardar el 30 de noviembre y las solicitudes recibidas después de dicha fecha podrán revisarse de manera continua hasta que se cubra el puesto. No se considerarán las solicitudes incompletas.
